page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance belonging to the High Clock Speed family. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this virtual machine provides 16 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor with an x86_64 architecture operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz. The configuration allocates 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 core-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU designed for computational tasks requiring high processing frequency without expansive memory overhead.

Network infrastructure for this instance type includes a baseline bandwidth capacity of 16 Gbps. The instance provides no bundled local NVMe storage and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring reliance on remote block storage solutions for operating system disks and persistent file systems. In addition, no hardware accelerators or GPUs are included on this host.

From a cost-efficiency standpoint, the 1:2 memory-to-vCPU allocation prevents overprovisioning RAM for compute-bound tasks, optimizing resource utilization. Tradeoffs include the complete absence of local disk I/O, which mandates network-attached storage integration, and the lack of included public IPv4 addressing. The ecs.hfc8i.4xlarge is suited for continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines, batch compute processes, video encoding, gaming server backends, and high-frequency web application serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance from the High Clock Speed server family powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, it features 16 dedicated vCPUs clocked at 3.3 GHz and 32.0 GB of system memory, delivering a focused 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance provides a baseline network throughput of 16 Gbps to support data transmission. Local disk storage is not bundled, necessitating external block storage for application and operating system data, and no discrete GPUs are present. By balancing a high clock speed against a compact memory footprint, this configuration offers hardware-level efficiency for compute-heavy workloads. The ecs.hfc8i.4xlarge is appropriate for CPU-bound tasks such as CI/CD runners, batch processing, application compilation, and web serving.
